newsitem.title: JAPAN: Harima Ceramic unit to form venture in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Harima Ceramic unit to form venture in Malaysia.

text.p: Japan's Micron Co Ltd, a joint venture between Harima Ceramic Co Ltd and Nippon Steel Corp, said on Monday it would form a company in Malaysia with Malayawata Steel Bhd to produce spherical silica powder. Spherical silica powder is used to make a material for semiconductor chips, a Micron spokesman said.
Harimic Malaysia Sdn Bhd, to be formed in Penang, Malaysia, will be 90 percent owned by Micron and 10 percent by Malayawata, he said.
The new firm will invest 900 million yen to build a plant, capable of producing 270 tonnes of spherical silica powder a month.
